programmer_art_hits: Flat or untextured surfaces: flat sails with light-leak smear, textureless pennant, teal-box lamp head, unshaded balcony rails, blurred dock slab (shots/critic5/zoom60_brig_crop_sail.png, shots/critic5/zoom60_town_crop_quay.png, shots/critic5/zoom60_town_crop_windows.png, shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_dock.png)

Visible tiling: far water a regular diagonal lattice at 300 m and at the sun-check horizon; beach a uniform micro-ripple grain (shots/critic5/zoom300_crop_top.png, shots/critic5/sun_check_crop_sky.png, shots/critic5/zoom60_beach_crop_shore.png)
White-stripe foam: noon foam comet off the mole tip in clear and fog (shots/critic5/contact_clear_12_crop_glitter.png, shots/critic5/contact_fog_12_crop_mole.png)

Fog as one colour: 17:30 fog a single grey-blue tone with inverted depth, 12:00 a white sheet (shots/critic5/fog_phone.png, shots/critic5/fog_phone_crop_near_water.png, shots/critic5/contact_fog_12.png)
top_issues: Water is a single-scale streaked plane: no swell, lattice at 300 m and horizon, no daylight reflections, no bow/mole foam, noon confetti with the foam comet (shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_bottom.png, shots/critic5/zoom300_crop_top.png, shots/critic5/zoom60_brig.png, shots/critic5/contact_clear_12_crop_glitter.png)
Fog is one grey-blue tone with inverted depth at 17:30 and a white sheet at 12:00 (shots/critic5/fog_phone.png, shots/critic5/fog_phone_crop_near_water.png, shots/critic5/contact_fog_12.png)
Sails are flat quads with the light-leak smear; pennant a textureless quad (shots/critic5/zoom60_brig_crop_sail.png)
Hillside is a bare tan dune with faint contour lines and smudges; no rock, no north cliff (shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_hill.png, shots/critic5/landscape_crop_hill.png)

Sky is a monotone warm-grey haze with no blue zenith or rose belt; glitter path clips to white; a fog sheet intersects near terrain (shots/critic5/sun_check.png, shots/critic5/sun_check_crop_glitter.png, shots/critic5/sun_check_crop_foreground.png)
Lamp heads are teal boxes, balconies unshaded bar cages, rigging bright orange (shots/critic5/zoom60_town_crop_quay.png, shots/critic5/zoom60_brig_crop_sail.png)
Quay and mole have no wet band; flagstone grid meets hex cobble apron at a hard step; boulders dry to the waterline (shots/critic5/zoom60_town_crop_quay.png, shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_mole.png)
Crates float beside the dock and off the beach; dock deck is a blurred slab (shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_dock.png, shots/critic5/zoom60_beach_crop_crate.png)
Moon light is a mottled blanket over the whole basin rather than a path (shots/critic5/night_phone_crop_basin.png)
17:30 shade is green-grey not violet, no warm bounce (shots/critic5/zoom60_town_crop_roof.png)
Hull has no wale stripe or waterline band (shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_brig.png)
Beach is one uniform grain with pink blotches, no debris (shots/critic5/zoom60_beach_crop_shore.png)
Roofs are paper-thin with no eaves (shots/critic5/zoom60_town_crop_roof.png)
Chimney smoke is faint flat smudges (shots/critic5/hero_phone_crop_town.png)
Hero lower 40% is an empty streaked plane; no sky in hero or landscape (shots/critic5/hero_phone.png, shots/critic5/landscape.png)
